verdicts.reason: A: the logo drops to the bottom, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits below the date and venue, and the URL comes before the time, so the reading order is jumbled. The RSVP CTA shrinks to a pill no bigger than the badges, the broken placeholder box floats mid-left, and the legal text is a tiny illegible block. B: the logo stays on top, but it has the same scrambled text stack (eyebrow below the details, URL above the time), the CTA is buried in a cramped 2x2 pill cluster at the bottom-left, the legal line is illegible, and a large dead band sits under the phone. It is less broken than A, but not shippable.
